pages.text: In a village you are devoted to, right-click the village altar holding an offering (a new village without a temple uses its foundation stone). That is an $(l)offering$().$(br2)Once per village per day. Your prayer favor from that village is $(l)+50%%$() that day, including what was already credited, so early or late makes no difference.

Any one of:$(li)Libation 1$(li)Honey bottle 1$(li)Cooked beef, mutton or porkchop 2$(li)Bread 2$(li)Wheat 8$(br)Offerings have nothing to do with relic $(l)offering slots$(); they only boost that day's prayer favor.
Each offering has its origin: the libation is the poured drink offering, cooked meat the animal sacrifice, bread the offering of cakes, and wheat the first share of the harvest given to the gods.
